$comment: Pi custom providers. This llmc provider block is a FALLBACK ONLY: the llmc-dynamic.ts extension (~/dotfiles/.pi/agent/extensions/llmc-dynamic.ts) fetches GET /v1/models from the live llmc proxy on startup and calls registerProvider, which REPLACES this models array wholesale with live preset data (id/name/reasoning/input/context/maxTokens all derived from the proxy's per-preset meta, not this file) - so in normal operation (proxy reachable) this list is inert. It only stands if the proxy is down/unreachable at pi startup, so the status bar isn't left blank. Keep it in sync with ~/infra/ai/llmc/models/*.toml anyway for that degraded path (verified 2026-09-10: two ninfer effort variants - qwen38-ninfer-low, qwen38-ninfer-d1 - were missing entirely, and the two present ninfer entries were missing input/cost). Pi reloads on /model open - no restart needed. NOTES: llmc = the llmc proxy on localhost:11434 (formerly 'llama-server'); apiKey ignored by proxy but Pi requires the field. compat block for llama-server: llama.cpp's OpenAI server has no developer role or reasoning_effort, both disabled at provider level. $comment keys inside samplingParams / openRouterRouting are NOT allowed - pi forwards those objects VERBATIM into the request body / provider field, and OpenRouter 400s with 'Unrecognized key' (seen 2026-08-19). Notes live at file root and modelOverride roots only.

moonshotai/kimi-k3.$comment: Routing prefers the official Moonshot AI deployment, falls back to the pool. repetition_penalty was removed 2026-08-23 during the reasoning-cliff investigation: a short-prompt A/B suggested suppression (19/39/29 with vs 37/173/93 without) but long-context probes did not reproduce it, and the cliff's degradation predated the penalty's addition, so it was not the cause. The 2026-08-19 '!' degenerate streams it was added for are contained by the degenerate-stream-guard extension instead. NOTE: $comment is only safe at THIS level - samplingParams and openRouterRouting are forwarded verbatim to the API, a $comment inside them 400s the request.

openrouter/auto.$comment: OpenRouter prices its router pseudo-models at -1 ('variable, depends on routed model'). Pi multiplies it straight through, so every auto turn subtracts its token count from session cost (footer showed $-150685 on 2026-08-11). Zero it: unknown is honest, negative is wrong. Same -1 sentinel on auto-beta and fusion.
